answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a nebula as the anchor of the cost.
